name: KMP Pattern Matching
description: Knuth-Morris-Pratt string searching algorithm finds all occurrences of a pattern in a text in O(n+m) time using a failure function.
aim: Search for pattern P in text T without redundant comparisons: precompute the failure function (longest proper prefix that is also a suffix) to skip re-checking.
howItWorks: Precompute failure function lps[]: lps[i] = length of longest proper prefix of pattern[0..i] that is also a suffix
Search: if pattern[j] == text[i]: advance both
If mismatch and j>0: use lps[j-1] to avoid going back in text

time.bestCase: Always O(n+m) — failure function ensures no revisiting

complexity.spaceDescription: Failure function array of size m (pattern length)

realWorld: Text search in editors (VS Code, vim)
whenToUse: Pattern has repeated structure (KMP excels here)
alternatives: Boyer-Moore — often faster in practice for long patterns
